meta.title: Mineger | Open-Source Minecraft Server Manager for Windows
meta.title_download: Download Mineger | Free Minecraft Server Manager for Windows
hero.kicker: Open-source Minecraft server manager for Windows
hero.title: Your Minecraft servers, without the command line.
hero.sub: Create vanilla, Paper or modded servers in a couple of clicks. Install modpacks from a link, mods from Modrinth and CurseForge, and let friends or bots manage the server with you.
hero.note: No account. No cloud. Your servers stay as folders on your disk.
kinds.title: Vanilla, Paper or modded: pick a kind, Mineger does the rest.
kinds.sub: Versions and loader builds come straight from the official sources, with the recommended build preselected.
kinds.vanilla.title: Vanilla
kinds.vanilla.text: The official Mojang server, downloaded and verified against its SHA1.
kinds.paper.title: Paper
kinds.paper.text: The optimised server that runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins.
kinds.modded.title: Modded
kinds.modded.text: NeoForge, Forge or Fabric, installed with the official installers. Java 8, 17 or 21 is picked for you.
packs.title: Install modpacks from a CurseForge, Modrinth or FTB link.
packs.text: CurseForge, Modrinth and FTB. When a modpack ships no server pack, Mineger builds one from the client pack and leaves client-only mods out.
packs.updates_text: Mineger checks for new modpack versions, backs up the world first and migrates your data, so nothing is lost.
mods.title: Search, install and update Minecraft mods from inside the app.
mods.text: Browse Modrinth and CurseForge filtered by your server's Minecraft version and loader. Every file shows where it came from, and updates with a button.
mods.li1: Compatibility filtered by version and loader
mods.li2: Source tracked per file, updates per mod
mods.li3: Drop your own .jar files any time
daily.title: Everything you need to run a Minecraft server, day to day.
daily.console.title: Live console
daily.console.text: Logs with highlighting, commands, and the last lines kept across restarts.
daily.metrics.title: CPU & RAM
daily.metrics.text: Live metrics of the Java process, memory set with a slider.
daily.props.title: server.properties
daily.props.text: An editor with descriptions, not a text file.
daily.backups.title: World backups
daily.backups.text: One click, zipped, kept next to the server.
daily.upnp.title: UPnP
daily.upnp.text: Open the port on your router from the app.
daily.icon.title: Server icon
daily.icon.text: Any image, resized to the 64×64 PNG the game wants.
daily.import.title: Import a server
daily.import.text: Drop a zip of an existing server: version and loader are detected for you.
daily.lang.title: Two languages
daily.lang.text: English (US or UK) and Italian, switched instantly. Adding one is a single JSON file.
friends.title: Remote control and webhooks: one PC hosts, everyone manages.
friends.text: Turn on host mode and share an invite link: other copies of Mineger control your servers remotely, over LAN or VPN. Per-server webhooks let Discord bots, Twitch extensions or plain scripts start, stop and talk to the server, each with its own token and permissions.
friends.li1: Invite link: address, port and token in one paste
friends.li2: Webhooks with per-action permissions and a command allow-list
friends.li3: Rate limiting, body limits and constant-time token checks built in
screens.title: Have a look around Mineger.
screens.overview: Server overview: live CPU and RAM, players, backups
screens.console: Console with highlighted logs and command input
screens.mods: Mods list with sources and update buttons
screens.modbrowser: Mod catalog filtered by version and loader
cta.title: Ready when you are.
cta.text: One installer, no account, servers in a couple of minutes.
cta.sub: Free and open source under the MIT license.
footer.made: Made by Daniel Crantoc. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
dl.title: Download Mineger for Windows 10 and 11
dl.sub: Free, open source, no account. Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit.
dl.req_java: Java 8, 17 or 21 depending on the Minecraft version. Mineger finds the installed runtimes and picks the right one.
dl.req_smart: The installer isn't signed yet, so Windows may warn you on first run. Choose More info → Run anyway.
dl.req_cf: Modrinth and FTB work out of the box. CurseForge needs your own free API key, pasted under Settings → CurseForge key.
dl.upgrade: Install over the previous version: servers and settings are kept.
